name: COMP_006
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (53%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Top-row regions drive risk, but flagged reliability, three-class conformal set, and frozen margins require deferral [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 53%, InSitu 31%, Benign 15%, Normal 2% [F1] | Split between Invasive and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, ECE 5%) | Cannot separate three classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 19% reliability (flagged), 100th percentile OOD (AUROC 70%) [F6] | Suspect out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Invasive (5/5 InSitu, 83%–87% similarity) [F5] | Neighbors favor InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 8, 9, 11) · context · Strongest weight (-1.21, opposes invasive) [F2]; 8/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Top driver (+1.11) [F3]; 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.51), weak, 0/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.35), 3/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Pushes invasive (+0.33); 18/20 AI spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops risk above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and unreliable necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is InSitu (31%) or Benign (15%), matching 5/5 nearest neighbors (83%–87% similarity; contrast BACH_0063).
- Composite frozen-section artifact or out-of-distribution input (100th percentile, 19% reliability) distorted high-risk regions 0–3.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Verify stromal invasion and pleomorphism versus InSitu; defer simulated frozen margins.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 6**: Check for true necrosis versus artifact, given the unreliable necrosis score (3/20).
3. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: Inspect low-risk regions for TILs and in situ atypia; consider drafted recut/deeper levels.
